title: Aisha Gallery
description: Handmade products made by strong Egyptian women, shipped worldwide

hero.headline: An Egyptian woman behind every stitch
hero.body: Handmade clothing, shawls and bags, shipped to you anywhere in the world.

story.body: Each piece is made slowly by strong Egyptian women, so no two come out exactly the same.

steps.body: We ship within Egypt and abroad.

closing.title: Found something you love?
closing.body: Message us on WhatsApp and we will help you choose.
